thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: unusual TPM spike observed for model-family 'guanaco-13b' in us-east-1. Error rate (5xx) climbing to 4.8% and queue latency > 800ms. Auto-scaling not keeping up.
ryan (oncall): Acknowledged. Paging oncall. I'm looking. Any customer-facing incidents yet? :eyes:
sam (sre): seeing a ~6x increase in request rate from a small number of API keys (likely a customer or runaway job). Many long-sequence requests (seq_len > 4096) causing KV cache churn.
maria (eng-runtime): preliminary heap/worker counts look okay. The runtime is hitting kernel fallback on some kernels for long sequences. Suggest immediate per-model quota change: throttle guanaco-13b TPM and RPM to cap burst while we investigate. Also consider disabling streaming for guanaco-13b or routing heavy sequences to guanaco-7b.
jess (support): Support reports 4 escalations so far from customers in the affected region, one enterprise customer (TCK-3412) seeing 5xx. We should notify them if we apply an aggressive throttle.
ryan (oncall): Agreed. Plan: 1) Apply conservative quota cap to guanaco-13b in us-east-1 2) Disable streaming & large-seq tool-calls for that family 3) Open customer comms and ask for rate reductions if needed. I'll run the quota change and monitor.
maria (eng-runtime): Suggested commands (runbook snippet):
```
# reduce TPM/RPM for guanaco-13b in us-east-1
rictl quota update --region us-east-1 --model guanaco-13b --tpm 2500 --rpm 40 --reason "emergency throttle - spike"
# optional: disable streaming
rictl feature toggle --region us-east-1 --model guanaco-13b --feature streaming --set off
```
Note: use the `--dry-run` first if you want to preview.
ryan (oncall): running the change now (will go live in ~15s).
devops-bot: Executing: `rictl quota update --region us-east-1 --model guanaco-13b --tpm 2500 --rpm 40 --reason "emergency throttle - spike"`
devops-bot: Success — quota change applied (propagated to edge config).
ryan (oncall): Confirming metric delta — TPS dropped ~55% for the family, 5xx rate falling to 1.1% in last 2 mins. Queue latency down to ~220ms. :thumbsup:
sam (sre): Good. Still seeing a tail of long requests. I'll add a temporary traffic-shape policy to deprioritize requests with seq_len > 4096:
```
rictl traffic-shape add --region us-east-1 --filter "seq_len>4096" --priority low --reason "reduce kv churn"
```
sam (sre): Implemented. Early signs: worker KV hit rate improved and lower kernel fallback.
jess (support): Sent initial note to TCK-3412 and two other customers: "We're applying temporary rate limits to guanaco-13b in us-east-1 to reduce errors; we'll follow up with ETA for full recovery." They responded acknowledging.
oliver (sales): Please add a short blurb for account managers in case they get pinged. Keep it factual.
ryan (oncall): Added to #customers-crashpad: "Applied temporary quotas and traffic-shaping for guanaco-13b in us-east-1 due to elevated error rates. Monitoring. Want updates? Ping me."
maria (eng-runtime): Next steps: 1) dig into which API keys sent long sequences 2) check rollout history for any new guanaco-13b variants 3) consider progressive rollback of recent model variants if correlated.
sam (sre): Running a quick query against logs to find top 10 API keys by token usage in last 30m. If it's a single customer, we can partner with support to get them to back off.
ryan (oncall): Also enabling finer-grain tracing for guanaco-13b for next 30m to capture KV miss patterns (added sample rate 10%).
devops-bot: Toggled tracing sample-rate for guanaco-13b -> 10% (30m).
incidents-bot: Created incident ticket INC-20260912-47, severity S2, linked to this thread.
jess (support): FYI one of the impacted accounts has an open enterprise contract; we'll prioritize a targeted ping.
maria (eng-runtime): If the quota change stabilizes traffic for 15-30m, we can consider relaxing RPM to a higher steady-state (e.g., 60) while keeping TPM lower to limit bursts.
ryan (oncall): Agreed. Let's give it 30 mins. Sam, can you own rotate/hand off after your monitoring window?
sam (sre): I can take the next 4 hours and then hand to Maria for the evening. I'll keep watch and have alert thresholds tightened: 5xx > 1.5% alerts now.
ryan (oncall): Noted. Action log: 
- 10:17:56Z incidents-bot alerted
- 10:18:10Z quota applied: guanaco-13b TPM 2500 RPM 40 (ryan / devops-bot)
- 10:18:40Z streaming disabled for family (optional)
- 10:19:10Z traffic-shape rule added for seq_len>4096 (sam)
- 10:20:00Z tracing sampling 10% enabled
- 10:21:00Z support notified customers TCK-3412 + 2

maria (eng-runtime): Recommend we prepare rollback commands in case of regression:
```
# rollback quota
rictl quota update --region us-east-1 --model guanaco-13b --tpm 10000 --rpm 200 --reason "rollback - incident mitigated"
# re-enable streaming
rictl feature toggle --region us-east-1 --model guanaco-13b --feature streaming --set on
```
ryan (oncall): I'll keep this thread sticky. If metrics hold for 30m, we'll archive and update INC ticket. If things worsen, escalate to oncall-2 and eng-runtime oncall.
jess (support): Logged incident impact in Zendesk tickets and created internal customer-notification draft.
oliver (sales): Thanks — please send me the final customer note, I'll help with any enterprise outreach.
sam (sre): Monitoring window started. Will report back every 10m or on any threshold breach.
incidents-bot: 10:27:36Z - 5xx trending down to 0.9% — mitigation appears effective.
ryan (oncall): Great. I'll schedule handoff notes and a short post-incident summary once we close. For now: keep throttle in place and keep tracking.
maria (eng-runtime): After we confirm stability, propose a small config change: enable token-based early-termination for requests > 8k tokens for guanaco-13b to avoid expensive tails. Discuss in follow-up.
ryan (oncall): Handoff: Sam will continue monitoring until 14:30Z, then Maria picks up. If anyone needs to escalate, ping @ryan and call PD.
sam (sre): Taking it. :white_check_mark:
incidents-bot: Incident INC-20260912-47 updated: mitigation in place, monitoring.
ryan (oncall): Closing note for thread — keeping as active incident until metrics stable for 1 hour. Will add runbook items after retro. Thanks team. :pray:
